messages:
alex kim: Quick heads-up — planning a coordinated deprecation: v1 client rename + model swap next Wed. Docs + snippets freeze Mon EOD. Who can own the PR queue and triage?
maria lopez: I can own docs PR triage. I'll spin up a checklist in the docs repo and tag snippet owners. Planning to add a migration guide and a 'what breaks' matrix.
sam o'neil: SDK team note: the rename lands in 0.9.0. We'll provide a small opt-in compat shim, but we should update examples to the new API. Suggest standardizing snippets to show the shim and the new form: `client = new RedwoodClient({ legacyCompat: true })`.
jia chen: From PM — we need a short customer-facing deprecation notice + FAQ. I'll draft customer copy. Prefer a 30/60/90-day timeline unless folks object.
alex kim: :thumbsup: 30/60/90 works. Maria, can you include a 'how to verify' checklist for SDKs and sample apps (smoke tests, expected error codes, embed dim checks)?
maria lopez: Yep. I'll add smoke tests and a curl example. Proposed quick curl snippet for docs: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v2/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"redwood-v2","input":"hello"}'
```
sam o'neil: Also note embed model swap: vector dims change. Add a migration note: redwood-embed-v1 (1536) -> redwood-embed-v2 (2048). We'll publish an index-migration script and a fallback mapping in the SDK.
jia chen: Flagging enterprise customers who have pinned v1 — we'll send pre-deprecation emails and offer assisted migration. Ops: can Dedicated keep a v1 toggle for pinned tenants during the 90-day window?
ci-bot: deploybot: PR #3487 (docs/migration/add-compat) merged to staging — staging build passed, no lint errors.
alex kim: Great. Maria, please include a rollback section (how to revert snippets + revert client usage) and ping @sam when docs PRs are ready so we can coordinate the release notes and the deprecation notice.
maria lopez: Will do. I'll post back in this thread when PRs are stacked and assign reviewers. Thanks!
